summary: Attempted to test the Master Admin ASER Settings panel per review request. Successfully logged in as admin@pulsefitness.com and reached /master-admin. However, the AdminMODConsole component (which renders the AserSettingsPanel with data-testid='aser-settings-panel' at its top) is not wired into the frontend routing or navigation at all. It is an orphan module — no import, no route, no sidebar entry references it. As a result the ASER settings panel is unreachable through the UI and cannot be tested.

ui_bugs.issue: AdminMODConsole.js (contains AserSettingsPanel at the top of admin-mod-console) is never imported/rendered anywhere in the app. `grep -rn AdminMODConsole /app/frontend/src` returns only the file itself. AppRoutes.js has no /admin/mod-console (or similar) route. The Master Admin sidebar (Overview, People, Organisations, Catalogue & Library, Finance, Marketing, Sales & Comms, Analytics, Partner Engineers, Integrations, Compliance & Security, Platform Tools) has no 'MOD Console' entry. The Overview → MoD sub-tab only renders modTabs=[{organisations}] which loads AdminOrganizations, not AdminMODConsole. Therefore the ASER settings UI is inaccessible.

action_items: Wire AdminMODConsole into the app: add a lazy import + route in /app/frontend/src/routes/AppRoutes.js (e.g. /admin/mod-console guarded by user?.is_master_admin), OR mount <AdminMODConsole/> inside OverviewSection.js under the MoD inner tab (add {id:'console', label:'MOD Console'} to modTabs and render it when modInnerTab==='console').
Add a sidebar/nav entry (e.g. 'MOD Console' under Master Admin) that navigates to that route/tab so admins can discover it.

Once wired, re-request testing agent to verify: panel expands, all controls (aser-set-enabled, -require-equip, -capex, -fault, -review, -pii, -ai, -threshold, -sm-*, -sd-*, -am-*) render, edits save via PUT /api/master-admin/aser/settings, success toast appears, and values persist across reload.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminMODConsole.js is a dead/unreachable module — the whole file (including the new AserSettingsPanel) is not shipped through any route.
The Phase 2 settings UI cannot be validated end-to-end until routing/nav is added; backend CRUD may be fine but the front-end deliverable is effectively missing.

seed_data_creation: None. No ASER settings were mutated since UI could not be opened.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AserSettingsPanel is defined in /app/frontend/src/pages/MasterAdmin/AdminMODConsole.js (line 437) and rendered inside AdminMODConsole (line 142). Once main agent adds a route or mounts AdminMODConsole under the Master Admin Overview MoD sub-tab, the panel should be reachable and the review-request steps (expand → change threshold to 3 → enable service desk + email → save → toast → reload persistence) can be executed. Backend endpoint: PUT /api/master-admin/aser/settings (deep-merges notifications).
rca of the issue: Component was authored but never wired: OverviewSection.js modTabs only contains 'organisations' and AppRoutes.js has no admin/mod-console route. Fix = add either a route entry or an additional modTabs entry that renders <AdminMODConsole API={API}/>.
